title.narrative: Rapid Response to Conflict and Electoral Violence in Cauca and Valle del Cauca, Colombia

description.narrative:
Response aimed at covering basic needs and psychosocial support to people affected by confinement and forced displacement due to electoral violence in the departments of Valle del Cauca and Cauca. Immediate humanitarian assistance will be provided through the distribution of shelters, non-perishable food and hygiene kits for forcibly displaced persons, preventing psychological and physical damage to those in need, particularly children and adolescents.
The areas for the intervention of PLAN are Jamundí, Valle del Cauca and Santander de Quilichao, Cauca.
Scope of Work: - The project seeks to provide a coordinated and timely response to address the immediate needs of IDPs and mitigate identified child protection, protection and psychosocial risks through the following actions: o Distribution of family hygiene kits o Distribution of child protection kits o Distribution of child protection kits o Distribution of Dignity Kits o Distribution of kits for pregnant and lactating women. o All kit distributions will be complemented by child-friendly mobile space activities focused on providing age-appropriate psychosocial, recreational and artistic activities to address the immediate psychosocial needs of affected children.
